title: Your bank says: move it now
scenario: A text claiming to be your bank says a $2,400 transfer is pending. A caller follows seconds later, knows your name, and says you must move your balance to a “protected account” before the transfer settles.

answers.A: Hang up and contact the bank through the number in its app or on your card; do not move money on an incoming caller’s instructions.
answers.B: Freeze the card/account in the bank app first, then contact the bank through a known channel.
answers.C: Move only part of the money to the protected account while you verify the rest.

explanation: Real fraud teams may act urgently, but they do not need you to transfer your own money to make it safe.
proTip: A “safe account” controlled by the caller is not safe.
